signals.title: Claude Code reports interrupted MCP calls explicitly instead of treating them as successful empty output
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将被中断的 MCP 调用显式标记为中断，不再当作成功空输出
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 fixes headless and remote MCP calls interrupted by an incoming message so the model receives an explicit interrupted error instead of a misleading completed-with-no-output result.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 修复 Headless 与 Remote 会话中因新消息而被中断的 MCP 调用：模型现在收到明确的 Interrupted Error，而不是误导性的“已完成但无输出”。

signals.title: Claude Code stops strict MCP sessions from requesting approval for servers they will never load
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 阻止 Strict MCP 会话为永不加载的 Server 请求审批
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 fixes --strict-mcp-config sessions prompting to approve .mcp.json servers that the strict configuration would never load, eliminating an unnecessary startup wait for background sessions.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 修复 --strict-mcp-config 会话仍要求审批实际不会加载的 .mcp.json Server 的问题，避免后台会话因虚假审批而在启动阶段等待。

signals.title: Claude Code binds third-party gateway API credentials to their configured host
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将第三方 Gateway API 凭据绑定到其配置 Host
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 prevents telemetry and metrics sent to Anthropic from carrying an API key configured for a third-party ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; a credential is sent only to its own host.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 阻止发往 Anthropic 的 Telemetry 与 Metrics 携带为第三方 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 配置的 API Key；凭据只会发送给其所属 Host。

signals.title: Claude Code makes requiresUserInteraction MCP tools non-bypassable by persistent allow rules
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让 requiresUserInteraction MCP Tool 无法被持久 Allow Rule 绕过
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 removes the 'Yes, and don’t ask again' option for MCP tools marked requiresUserInteraction, preventing creation of an allow rule that the tool's mandatory interaction contract would ignore.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 对标记 requiresUserInteraction 的 MCP Tool 移除“以后不再询问”选项，避免生成与工具强制人工交互合同冲突的持久 Allow Rule。

signals.title: Claude Code automatically continues non-interactive responses interrupted by transport failures
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 自动续接因传输故障中断的非交互响应
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 makes -p, SDK and cloud sessions automatically continue a response cut off mid-stream by a server error, connection loss or stall rather than ending the run immediately with an error.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 让 -p、SDK 与 Cloud Session 在响应因 Server Error、连接丢失或 Stall 中途截断时自动继续，而不是立即以错误结束运行。

signals.title: Claude Code marks max-turn subagent results as partial instead of finished
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将达到 MaxTurns 的 Subagent 结果标记为 Partial 而非 Finished
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 changes a subagent that stops at maxTurns to return its output explicitly marked partial with a continuation hint, instead of presenting truncated work as completed.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 让因 maxTurns 停止的 Subagent 将输出明确标记为 Partial，并给出继续提示，不再把被截断的工作呈现为已完成。

signals.title: Claude Code isolates concurrent review and cloud launches from another worktree's uncommitted state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 隔离并发 Review 与 Cloud Launch，避免混入其他 Worktree 的未提交状态
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 fixes simultaneous /ultrareview and cloud launches from one repository, including multiple worktrees, occasionally starting with another launch's uncommitted changes.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 修复同一仓库（包括多个 Worktree）同时启动 /ultrareview 与 Cloud Session 时，某次 Launch 偶尔携带另一 Launch 未提交改动的问题。

signals.title: Claude Code keeps self-hosted runners alive across malformed work-poll responses
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让 Self-hosted Runner 在异常 Work-poll Response 下保持存活
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 changes the self-hosted runner to retry when a work-poll response is malformed, such as an intercepting proxy returning HTML, instead of ending live sessions or exiting.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 让 Self-hosted Runner 在 Work-poll Response 异常（例如代理返回 HTML）时重试，不再因此结束 Live Session 或直接退出。

signals.title: Claude Code hardens Bash permission matching against wildcard overreach and malformed command tails
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 加固 Bash Permission Matching，防止 Wildcard 过度匹配与畸形命令尾部绕过
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 adds a startup warning for Bash allow rules whose wildcard precedes the subcommand because they also match inserted options, and forces approval for malformed commands ending in dangling && or || operators.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 对 Wildcard 位于 Subcommand 前的 Bash Allow Rule 增加启动警告，因为它也会匹配插入的 Option；同时对以悬空 && 或 || 结尾的畸形命令强制要求审批。

signals.title: Codex binds enterprise IdP sessions, identity claims and MCP resource indicators to OAuth issuer and server identity
signals.title_zh: Codex 将企业 IdP Session、Identity Claim 与 MCP Resource Indicator 绑定到 OAuth Issuer 与 Server Identity
signals.summary: Codex resolves stored enterprise IdP sessions against authorization metadata, binds OIDC claims and MCP resource indicators to issuer/client/server identity, requires reauthentication after pinned credential replacement, and isolates enterprise credentials by namespace and Codex home.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 依据 Authorization Metadata 解析已存企业 IdP Session，将 OIDC Claim 与 MCP Resource Indicator 绑定到 Issuer、Client 和 Server Identity，在固定凭据被替换后要求重新认证，并按 Namespace 与 Codex Home 隔离企业凭据。

signals.title: Codex preserves unstructured MCP tool results as typed content items
signals.title_zh: Codex 将非结构化 MCP Tool Result 保留为 Typed Content Item
signals.summary: Codex converts unstructured MCP results into typed function-call output items instead of serializing the entire content array into text, while preserving media, encrypted and unknown content through existing conversions and dropping empty text items during truncation.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将非结构化 MCP Result 转为 Typed Function-call Output Item，而不是把整个 Content Array 序列化成文本；同时通过既有转换保留 Media、Encrypted 与 Unknown Content，并在 Truncation 时丢弃空文本项。

signals.title: Codex preserves attachment-owned permission profiles for MCP servers across runtime refreshes
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Runtime Refresh 后仍保留 MCP Server 的 Attachment-owned Permission Profile
signals.summary: Codex resolves and captures a permission profile for each enabled MCP server when publishing the runtime, rejects calls when authority is unavailable, and reuses that server profile for approvals, elicitation and sandbox metadata even after runtime refreshes.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在发布 Runtime 时为每个启用的 MCP Server 解析并捕获 Permission Profile，在权限不可用时拒绝调用，并在 Runtime Refresh 后继续用该 Server Profile 处理审批、Elicitation 与 Sandbox Metadata。

signals.title: Codex continuously tests exec-server compatibility against current, stable and minimum supported releases
signals.title_zh: Codex 持续测试 Exec-server 对当前、稳定版与最低支持版本的兼容性
signals.summary: Codex adds Bazel tests that run a shared Noise relay compatibility suite in both app-server/exec-server directions against the current build, stable release 0.149.1 and minimum supported 0.145.0 on Linux x86-64.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增 Bazel 测试，在 App-server/Exec-server 双向运行共享 Noise Relay 兼容性套件，覆盖当前构建、稳定版 0.149.1 与最低支持版 0.145.0（Linux x86-64）。

signals.title: Google ADK makes detached dynamic-node failure or interruption fail the enclosing workflow
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 让 Detached Dynamic Node 的失败或中断使所属 Workflow 失败
signals.summary: ADK now awaits detached dynamic-node runs that remain in flight after static graph work completes and propagates their failures or interruptions instead of allowing the workflow to report success while detached work failed.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在会在 Static Graph 工作完成后等待仍在运行的 Detached Dynamic Node，并传播其 Failure 或 Interruption，不再允许 Detached Work 已失败而 Workflow 仍报告成功。

signals.title: Google ADK resolves function responses against the invocation that actually issued each tool call
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 按实际发起 Tool Call 的 Invocation 解析 Function Response
signals.summary: ADK's node path now resolves each function response against the invocation that issued its call, preventing a caller-supplied invocation id from silently discarding tool results and detecting responses that straddle multiple invocations.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 的 Node Path 现在将每个 Function Response 解析到实际发起该调用的 Invocation，避免 Caller-supplied Invocation ID 导致 Tool Result 被静默丢弃，并能检测跨多个 Invocation 的 Response。

signals.title: Google ADK prevents RunConfig HTTP option copies from crashing or leaking mutable state across invocations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 防止复制 RunConfig HTTP Option 时崩溃或跨 Invocation 泄漏可变状态
signals.summary: ADK replaces unsafe deep copies of RunConfig.http_options with mutation-specific copies, sharing live clients by reference but copying mutable containers so callbacks cannot mutate the caller's RunConfig and leak state into later runs.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 用面向实际修改项的 Copy 替代对 RunConfig.http_options 的不安全 Deep Copy：Live Client 保持引用共享，但可变容器独立复制，避免 Callback 修改 Caller RunConfig 并把状态泄漏到后续运行。

signals.title: Google ADK redacts credentials from DebugLoggingPlugin output files
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 从 DebugLoggingPlugin 输出文件中脱敏凭据
signals.summary: ADK changes DebugLoggingPlugin output-file handling to redact credentials, tightening the boundary between observability artifacts and secret material.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修改 DebugLoggingPlugin 的输出文件处理，对凭据进行脱敏，收紧可观测性 Artifact 与 Secret Material 之间的边界。

signals.title: Google ADK forces nested AgentTool runs into unary mode so tool results cannot end on a partial stream chunk
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 强制嵌套 AgentTool 使用 Unary Mode，避免 Tool Result 以 Partial Stream Chunk 结束
signals.summary: ADK makes AgentTool nested agents run with StreamingMode.NONE because nested events are not forwarded; the tool response now uses a complete final content value rather than risking a partial last streaming chunk.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 让 AgentTool 的嵌套 Agent 使用 StreamingMode.NONE，因为嵌套事件本就不会向调用方转发；Tool Response 因此使用完整最终内容，不再可能只拿到最后一个 Partial Streaming Chunk。
